buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Inspection 1.1 The firm shall provide, on its letterhead, a confirmation indicating the inspection place. 2. Payment Terms 2.1 Payment shall be made at 100% of the contract value after receipt and acceptance of the material by t he consignee at the destination. 2.2 No advance payment shall be admissible under this contract. 3. Warranty 3.1 The material supplied under this contract shall be warranted for a period of 30 (Thirty) months. 3.2 The warranty shall be governed by the IRS Terms and Conditions of Contract. 3.3 During the warranty period, the supplier shall be responsible for rectification/replacement of defective material at no additional cost to the purchaser. 4. Source of Procurement 4.1 Procurement shall be made only from the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or their authorized d ealers. 4.2 In case the bidder is an authorized dealer, a bid-specific OEM Authorization Letter must be submitted a long with the Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) 4.3 The OEM and its authorized dealer(s) shall not be permitted to participate simultaneously in the same t ender. 4.4 In the event that both the OEM and its authorized dealer(s) submit bids in the same tender, the bids of all authorized dealers shall be summarily rejected, and only the OEM’s bid shall be considered. 4.5 Bids submitted by authorized dealers without a bid-specific OEM Authorization Letter and EMD shall be summarily rejected. 5. BIS Certification 5.1 The bidder shall submit a copy of a valid BIS License Certificate along with the bid. 5.2 Failure to submit a valid BIS License Certificate, the offer will be summarily rejected. 6. Test Report 6.1 The bidder shall submit a test report in accordance with IS:7098 (Part 1): 1988, latest 6.2 The test report shall be issued by a Government Laboratory/NABL/ILAC accredited laboratory. 6.3 The test report shall not be older than THREE years from the date of bid submission. 6.4 The following details shall be clearly indicated in the test report: a) Test Report Number b) Date of Issue c) Name of the Laboratory d) Complete Address of the Laboratory. 6.5 The test report must correspond to the size of cable quoted by the bidder. 6.6 Non-submission of the required test report or submission of incomplete/invalid documents the offer will be summarily rejected.

7. Marking and packing: Brand, 1.1 KV, Size, BIS license number and Year of manufacturing must be marke d/printed on each meter of the cable supplied. 8.ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 9. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates/documents specified in t he Bid document, ATC, along with their offer. No fresh documents shall be entertained at the stage of repr esentation . 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of FA AND CAO/C/LKO payable at LUCKNOW . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C FA AND CAO/C/LUCKNOW . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of FA AND CAO/C/LKO payable at LUCKNOW . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of FA AND CAO/C/LKO A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
